rows.text: SPA, date line Jeddah 28 Rajab 1433 / 18 June 2012: 'وجه صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود ولي العهد نائب رئيس مجلس الوزراء وزير الدفاع' that the regional emirs receive the citizens' pledge on his behalf, in a cable to the Minister of Interior quoted in the item.
rows.locator: Date line; first and second paragraphs; trailer 23:38 (Makkah time)

rows.text: The item says that for the Riyadh region he would himself receive the pledge at Qasr al-Hukm in Riyadh 'يومي السبت والأحد 3 و 4/8/1433هـ بعد صلاة الظهر'.
